flange_v1 fails at baseline, and no single-parameter change within the constraints reaches SF 2.0. I reported `no_fix_possible`, left the part unchanged and did not save it.

Baseline SF is 0.212 (peak stress 848.5 MPa against 180 MPa yield) under 8000 N in -Z on `face_mating`. This is revision 1, which is the latest.

| Parameter change | SF |
|---|---|
| `thickness_mm` 2 → 5 (sheet stock limit) | 0.839 |
| `hole_diameter_mm` 10 → 4 (M4 minimum) | 0.354 |
| `fillet_radius_mm` 1.5 → 6 | 0.212 (no effect) |

Each probe was reverted before the next, and the part is back at its original values.

Lesson recording was disabled for this run, so none were stored.
